boolean_operators.note: AND, OR, NOT, NEAR/x, and SAME are passed unchanged; documented precedence is recorded below

wildcards.note: passed unchanged to native editor; documented position/Latin-alphabet rules are not rewritten

exact_phrases.note: passed unchanged to native editor; quotes are source semantics

automatic_variants.note: source-controlled by language, term, wildcard, quotes, and Exact Search state

field_tags.finding: Advanced Query Builder accepts exact raw field-tag expressions; current official Core Collection tags include TS, TI, AB, AK, AU, AD, SO, DOP, PY, FPY, WC, SU, SDG, TMAC, TMSO, TMIC, UT and related record fields.
field_tags.live_contrast: UT known-item positive; exact editor echo required

boolean_precedence.finding: NEAR/x > SAME > NOT > AND > OR; parentheses override. Adjacent terms imply AND in most fields, with documented language exceptions. The newer Search Rules page says All Fields allows 100 Boolean/proximity operators while Search Operators says 49; the official cap is therefore not normalized client-side.
boolean_precedence.live_contrast: known-item OR known-item AND impossible-title-term stayed positive; parenthesized equivalent was native zero

wildcards.finding: * is zero-or-more characters, ? is one character, and $ is zero-or-one; wildcard positions and minimum context depend on field. Wildcards disable lemmatization and are Latin-alphabet-only.
wildcards.live_contrast: TI=(nanosatellit*) and TI=(*satellite) accepted the known item; TI=(nanosatellite?) and TI=(nanosatellite$) accepted its plural-title contrast; TI=(low*cost) did not

variants_and_exactness.finding: Exact Search is off by default in the Query Builder; off applies stemming/lemmatization, while on restricts terms. Quotes disable lemmatization/synonym expansion; spelling and inflection behavior remains source-controlled by term/language.
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: bounded TI=(mouse) count differed from quoted and Exact Search-on states; source cap made this diagnostic-only

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Quoted phrases require order; WOS documents hyphen/space normalization for hyphenated query terms and recommends both forms for names. Do not generalize punctuation behavior beyond documented fields.
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: known title low-cost matched TI=(low-cost) and TI=(low cost); quoted reversed phrase was native zero

proximity.finding: NEAR/x uses the maximum number of separating words; NEAR defaults to /15 and /0 means adjacent. SAME is an Address same-address grouping operator, not a generic token-distance operator. NEAR/SAME are unsupported in All Fields, and AND cannot be nested inside NEAR. Clarivate does not state a NEAR direction rule.

same_address.address_evidence: Address 1 contains Fac Elect Engn Math & Comp Sci and Address 2 contains Fac Aerosp Engn; both are under Delft Univ Technol.
positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Delft)
UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Delft SAME Elect Engn)
same_address.and_control_positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn AND Aerosp Engn)
same_address.different_address_native_zero: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Aerosp Engn)

near_direction.observation: Both operand orders were native positive for adjacent terms in TI, TS, AB, AD, and CF. TI low NEAR/0 nanosatellite was a native zero because cost separates the terms, providing the distance control.

language_and_document_type.finding: Language is a record-language restriction whose official fielded-search default is All languages; Document Type is a separate fielded restriction and records may have Article plus Proceedings Paper. LA/DT raw clauses were accepted live but are not listed in the current Core Collection advanced-tag article.
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: known English Article matched LA=(English) and DT=(Article), while French/Review were native zero

dates.finding: PY searches Source Published year and includes both Published Early Access Year and Final Publication Year. FPY searches only the final publication year. DOP searches the source publication date, accepts calendar precision including month/day, and documented ranges are inclusive; its Early Access-versus-final basis is not explicitly documented.

live_contrast.observation: Three current records displayed Early Access in 2024 and final Published dates in 2025. Each matched PY=(2024), PY=(2025), FPY=(2025), and its Early Access month in DOP; each was native zero for FPY=(2024) and the displayed final-month DOP query. The first record's DOP month/range was positive while DOP day queries 2024-08-01 and 2024-08-17 were native zero, so its Indexed day is not substituted for DOP precision.
live_contrast.final_only_control: The known WOS:A1996WG26700022 record displayed Published JUL-AUG 1996 with no Early Access line and matched its 1996 PY/DOP contrasts; this does not establish a time zone.

editions.finding: Core Collection exposes ten index families in the current UI, but availability depends on subscription and the picker is dynamic. Edition subsets change scope; cross-indexed records can match more than one subset.
editions.live_contrast: one known Proceedings Paper matched CPCI-S but not SCI-EXPANDED; one journal record matched SCI-EXPANDED but not CPCI-S

time_zone.finding: The current official documentation and bounded UI contrasts specify calendar-date inclusivity/precision but no publication-date time zone. The adapter does not infer one.

boolean_operators.note: AND, OR, NOT, NEAR/x, and SAME are passed unchanged; documented precedence is recorded below

wildcards.note: passed unchanged to native editor; documented position/Latin-alphabet rules are not rewritten

field_tags.finding: Advanced Query Builder accepts exact raw field-tag expressions; current official Core Collection tags include TS, TI, AB, AK, AU, AD, SO, DOP, PY, FPY, WC, SU, SDG, TMAC, TMSO, TMIC, UT and related record fields.
field_tags.live_contrast: UT known-item positive; exact editor echo required

boolean_precedence.finding: NEAR/x > SAME > NOT > AND > OR; parentheses override. Adjacent terms imply AND in most fields, with documented language exceptions. The newer Search Rules page says All Fields allows 100 Boolean/proximity operators while Search Operators says 49; the official cap is therefore not normalized client-side.
boolean_precedence.live_contrast: known-item OR known-item AND impossible-title-term stayed positive; parenthesized equivalent was native zero

wildcards.finding: * is zero-or-more characters, ? is one character, and $ is zero-or-one; wildcard positions and minimum context depend on field. Wildcards disable lemmatization and are Latin-alphabet-only.
wildcards.live_contrast: TI=(nanosatellit*) and TI=(*satellite) accepted the known item; TI=(nanosatellite?) and TI=(nanosatellite$) accepted its plural-title contrast; TI=(low*cost) did not

variants_and_exactness.finding: Exact Search is off by default in the Query Builder; off applies stemming/lemmatization, while on restricts terms. Quotes disable lemmatization/synonym expansion; spelling and inflection behavior remains source-controlled by term/language.
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: bounded TI=(mouse) count differed from quoted and Exact Search-on states; source cap made this diagnostic-only

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Quoted phrases require order; WOS documents hyphen/space normalization for hyphenated query terms and recommends both forms for names. Do not generalize punctuation behavior beyond documented fields.
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: known title low-cost matched TI=(low-cost) and TI=(low cost); quoted reversed phrase was native zero

proximity.finding: NEAR/x uses the maximum number of separating words; NEAR defaults to /15 and /0 means adjacent. SAME is an Address same-address grouping operator, not a generic token-distance operator. NEAR/SAME are unsupported in All Fields, and AND cannot be nested inside NEAR. Clarivate does not state a NEAR direction rule.

same_address.address_evidence: Address 1 contains Fac Elect Engn Math & Comp Sci and Address 2 contains Fac Aerosp Engn; both are under Delft Univ Technol.
positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Delft)
UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Delft SAME Elect Engn)
same_address.and_control_positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn AND Aerosp Engn)
same_address.different_address_native_zero: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Aerosp Engn)

near_direction.observation: Both operand orders were native positive for adjacent terms in TI, TS, AB, AD, and CF. TI low NEAR/0 nanosatellite was a native zero because cost separates the terms, providing the distance control.

language_and_document_type.finding: Language is a record-language restriction whose official fielded-search default is All languages; Document Type is a separate fielded restriction and records may have Article plus Proceedings Paper. LA/DT raw clauses were accepted live but are not listed in the current Core Collection advanced-tag article.
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: known English Article matched LA=(English) and DT=(Article), while French/Review were native zero

dates.finding: PY searches Source Published year and includes both Published Early Access Year and Final Publication Year. FPY searches only the final publication year. DOP searches the source publication date, accepts calendar precision including month/day, and documented ranges are inclusive; its Early Access-versus-final basis is not explicitly documented.

live_contrast.observation: Three current records displayed Early Access in 2024 and final Published dates in 2025. Each matched PY=(2024), PY=(2025), FPY=(2025), and its Early Access month in DOP; each was native zero for FPY=(2024) and the displayed final-month DOP query. The first record's DOP month/range was positive while DOP day queries 2024-08-01 and 2024-08-17 were native zero, so its Indexed day is not substituted for DOP precision.
live_contrast.final_only_control: The known WOS:A1996WG26700022 record displayed Published JUL-AUG 1996 with no Early Access line and matched its 1996 PY/DOP contrasts; this does not establish a time zone.

editions.finding: Core Collection exposes ten index families in the current UI, but availability depends on subscription and the picker is dynamic. Edition subsets change scope; cross-indexed records can match more than one subset.
editions.live_contrast: one known Proceedings Paper matched CPCI-S but not SCI-EXPANDED; one journal record matched SCI-EXPANDED but not CPCI-S

time_zone.finding: The current official documentation and bounded UI contrasts specify calendar-date inclusivity/precision but no publication-date time zone. The adapter does not infer one.

boolean_operators.note: AND, OR, NOT, NEAR/x, and SAME are passed unchanged; documented precedence is recorded below

field_tags.finding: Advanced Query Builder accepts exact raw field-tag expressions; current official Core Collection tags include TS, TI, AB, AK, AU, AD, SO, DOP, PY, FPY, WC, SU, SDG, TMAC, TMSO, TMIC, UT and related record fields.
field_tags.live_contrast: UT known-item positive; exact editor echo required

boolean_precedence.finding: NEAR/x > SAME > NOT > AND > OR; parentheses override. Adjacent terms imply AND in most fields, with documented language exceptions. The newer Search Rules page says All Fields allows 100 Boolean/proximity operators while Search Operators says 49; the official cap is therefore not normalized client-side.
boolean_precedence.live_contrast: known-item OR known-item AND impossible-title-term stayed positive; parenthesized equivalent was native zero

wildcards.finding: * is zero-or-more characters, ? is one character, and $ is zero-or-one; wildcard positions and minimum context depend on field. Wildcards disable lemmatization and are Latin-alphabet-only.
wildcards.live_contrast: TI=(nanosatellit*) and TI=(*satellite) accepted the known item; TI=(nanosatellite?) and TI=(nanosatellite$) accepted its plural-title contrast; TI=(low*cost) did not

variants_and_exactness.finding: Exact Search is off by default in the Query Builder; off applies stemming/lemmatization, while on restricts terms. Quotes disable lemmatization/synonym expansion; spelling and inflection behavior remains source-controlled by term/language.
variants_and_exactness.live_contrast: bounded TI=(mouse) count differed from quoted and Exact Search-on states; source cap made this diagnostic-only

hyphens_spaces_phrases.finding: Quoted phrases require order; WOS documents hyphen/space normalization for hyphenated query terms and recommends both forms for names. Do not generalize punctuation behavior beyond documented fields.
hyphens_spaces_phrases.live_contrast: known title low-cost matched TI=(low-cost) and TI=(low cost); quoted reversed phrase was native zero

proximity.finding: NEAR/x uses the maximum number of separating words; NEAR defaults to /15 and /0 means adjacent. SAME is an Address same-address grouping operator, not a generic token-distance operator. NEAR/SAME are unsupported in All Fields, and AND cannot be nested inside NEAR. Clarivate does not state a NEAR direction rule.

same_address.address_evidence: Address 1 contains Fac Elect Engn Math & Comp Sci and Address 2 contains Fac Aerosp Engn; both are under Delft Univ Technol.
positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Delft)
UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Delft SAME Elect Engn)
same_address.and_control_positive: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn AND Aerosp Engn)
same_address.different_address_native_zero: UT=(WOS:000414287001058) AND AD=(Elect Engn SAME Aerosp Engn)

near_direction.observation: Both operand orders were native positive for adjacent terms in TI, TS, AB, AD, and CF. TI low NEAR/0 nanosatellite was a native zero because cost separates the terms, providing the distance control.

language_and_document_type.finding: Language is a record-language restriction whose official fielded-search default is All languages; Document Type is a separate fielded restriction and records may have Article plus Proceedings Paper. LA/DT raw clauses were accepted live but are not listed in the current Core Collection advanced-tag article.
language_and_document_type.live_contrast: known English Article matched LA=(English) and DT=(Article), while French/Review were native zero

dates.finding: PY searches Source Published year and includes both Published Early Access Year and Final Publication Year. FPY searches only the final publication year. DOP searches the source publication date, accepts calendar precision including month/day, and documented ranges are inclusive; its Early Access-versus-final basis is not explicitly documented.

live_contrast.observation: Three current records displayed Early Access in 2024 and final Published dates in 2025. Each matched PY=(2024), PY=(2025), FPY=(2025), and its Early Access month in DOP; each was native zero for FPY=(2024) and the displayed final-month DOP query. The first record's DOP month/range was positive while DOP day queries 2024-08-01 and 2024-08-17 were native zero, so its Indexed day is not substituted for DOP precision.
live_contrast.final_only_control: The known WOS:A1996WG26700022 record displayed Published JUL-AUG 1996 with no Early Access line and matched its 1996 PY/DOP contrasts; this does not establish a time zone.

editions.finding: Core Collection exposes ten index families in the current UI, but availability depends on subscription and the picker is dynamic. Edition subsets change scope; cross-indexed records can match more than one subset.
